chunks: Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd, from al-Naḍr ibn Suwayd, from Yaḥyā al-Ḥalabī, from Muʿallā ibn ʿUthmān, from Abū Baṣīr, who said:
He عليه السلام said to me: “Indeed, al-Ḥakam ibn ʿUtaybah is among those about whom Allah said:”
“And among the people are those who say: We believe in Allah and in the Last Day, while they are not believers.”
So let al-Ḥakam go east and go west. Indeed, by Allah, he will not attain the knowledge except from a Household upon whom Jibrāʾīl descended.

key_terms.آمَنَّا: we believe; a verbal claim of faith mentioned in the Qur’anic citation
key_terms.أَهْلِ بَيْتٍ: the Household, referring to Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام
key_terms.الْحَكَمَ بْنَ عُتَيْبَةَ: al-Ḥakam ibn ʿUtaybah, the individual criticized in the narration
key_terms.الْعِلْمَ: the knowledge, meaning true divinely guided knowledge
key_terms.الْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ: the Last Day, referring to the final resurrection and judgment

ai.seo_question: From whom can true divine knowledge be attained according to this hadith of al-Kāfī?
ai.summary: This hadith identifies true divine knowledge as being exclusively with Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام, upon whom Jibrāʾīl descended. It also applies the Qur’anic description of false claimants of faith to al-Ḥakam ibn ʿUtaybah, underscoring the Shia doctrine of religious authority and authentic transmission from the Imams عليهم السلام.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Al Nazar Bin Suweyd, from Yahya Al Halby, from Moalla Biin Usman, 
(It has been narrated)
from Abu Baseer who said, ‘He<sup>asws</sup> said to me: ‘Al-Hakam Bin Oteyba is from the ones for whom Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Said
[2:8] And from the people there are ones who are saying: We believe in Allah and the Last Day; and they are not at all Believers.

So let Al-Hakam go east and let him go west. But, by Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, he will not attain the knowledge except from the People<sup>asws</sup> of the Household. Jibraeel<sup>as</sup> descends unto them<sup>asws</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 4. Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd from Yahya al-Halabi from Mu‘alla ibn ‘Uthman who has said the following. “ Abu Basir
said to me, ‘Al-Hakam ibn ‘Utayba is of those people about whom Allah has said,
“Some people say, “We believe in God and the Day of Judgment,” but they are not true believers.” [2:8]
Al-Hakam may easternize or westernize, he, by Allah, will not find the true knowledge in no other source except from Ahl al-Bayt to whom Jibril came (with knowledge).”
